name: Blue Bobcat 63
author: btongheng
description: Neon rounded blue button that responds while pressed down.
howItWorks: While pressed, letter-spacing becomes 0px, transform becomes skew(-10deg) translateY(8px), box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 var(--😀😀😀).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Blue Bobcat 63</title>
<style>
/* Blue Bobcat 63 by btongheng — https://uiverse.io/btongheng/blue-bobcat-63 */
.button {
  --😀: #644dff;
  --😀😀: #4836bb;
  --😀😀😀: #654dff63;
  cursor: pointer;
  width: 234px;
  height: 58px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  font-size: 1.125em;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #fff;
  background: var(--😀);
  border: 2px solid var(--😀😀);
  border-radius: .75rem;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 0 var(--😀😀);
  transform: skew(-10deg);
  transition: all .1s ease;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 15px 20px var(--😀😀😀));
}

.button:active {
  letter-spacing: 0px;
  transform: skew(-10deg) translateY(8px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--😀😀😀);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  BUTTON
</button>

</body>
</html>
